QuestInfo.name: The Way to Papulatus
QuestInfo.0: #p2041023# claims to know how to get rid of Papulatus. Listen to her.
QuestInfo.1: #p2041023# says you need #t4031172# and #t4031179# to encounter Papulatus. Get the necessary items from #p2041023#. \r\n
QuestInfo.2: You got instructions on how to find and defeat #p2041023#.\r\n

0.0: Oh me, oh my. It looks like you've lost something very important. It's the only one in the entire world, but don't worry, I have another one! Do you want it?

yes.0: Now, where did I put it? Just give me a second to find it...

no.0: I get it. You need some time to talk yourself into it.
